title: rclpy Basics: Building Robust ROS 2 Nodes in Python
description: This chapter delves into the fundamental aspects of rclpy, the Python client library for ROS 2. You will learn how to initialize and structure ROS 2 nodes, manage parameters, and understand the lifecycle of a ROS 2 application written in Python. This chapter complements the previous discussions on nodes, topics, and services by focusing on the rclpy programming interface.
